name: DS Cluster D15: News + Cross-Sectional News
description: Tests: news with tickers option, cs_news with required tickers list.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D15: News + Cross-Sectional News
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === SINGLE-ASSET NEWS ===
n = news()()
had_news = is_valid(n.title)

# === CROSS-SECTIONAL NEWS (requires tickers) ===
csn = cs_news(tickers=["MSFT", "GOOGL"])()
had_cs_news = is_valid(csn.title)

# === REPORTERS ===
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.NewspaperIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="News"
    )
)((close, had_news))

histogram(category="News", title="Close on News Days", bins=20)(where(had_news, close))
